content: Hi, I'm Alice. I just started at Helix Labs last week as a senior backend engineer.
Welcome, Alice! That sounds exciting. What will you be working on at Helix Labs?
I'll be leading the migration of the legacy ingestion service to microservices. The project is called Phoenix. We're targeting Q3 2025 for production rollout.
That's a significant undertaking. What tech stack are you planning to use for the new services?

We'll keep Python and Kafka for streaming, but we're switching from a monolith to containerized services on Kubernetes. I'm also evaluating replacing PostgreSQL with a time-series database for the metrics layer.
Interesting choice. Have you finalized which time-series database you'd go with?
We decided to go with InfluxDB after a two-week evaluation. Also, the Q3 2025 deadline got moved up — management now wants an MVP by Q1 2025.
That's a tight timeline. How is the team responding to the accelerated schedule?
